## Activity

During November 2021, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 378 captures. Activity was delivered through the clinic’s scheduled sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 20 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.3. The result identifies the number of image sets that could not be used for grading and provides a clear measure of image quality for the month. The remaining captures progressed through the grading process.

## Grading

A total of 79 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 8 days. This records the central grading turnaround for the month and should be considered alongside the referable results and the image-quality findings. Overall, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures provide the operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic in November 2021.
